red.assertion: Lost admission/control acknowledgements are invisible to recovery.

verified: Admission and owner-control acknowledgements are recovered from durable uncertain state without reapplying their commands. Restart regression preserves the single owner-control revision.

Recovery loads only the configured bot/owner principal and validates serialized origin, request ID, response ID and admission/control namespace uniqueness. Legacy stores without the newer control table remain readable.
The production reconnect worker verifies live private-recipient authority before history and before recording an exact message receipt.

Command acknowledgements must end with their original immutable request marker. Both acknowledgement and progress recovery share the same bounded exact-message history reader, requiring unique configured-bot author, exact content and bound destination.
Production gateway-adapter regression injects a lost pause acknowledgement, confirms it through history, then verifies repeated recovery adds no sends and leaves owner-control revision unchanged.
limits: History is limited to 100 recent messages and a 15-second request deadline. Missing, altered, ambiguous or unavailable evidence leaves the attempt uncertain.
Explicit message resolution, owner-authorized duplicate-risk resend, typed backoff/degraded/dead-letter handling and delivery rebind remain open.
Native PR sessions, full lifecycle controls, operational routing, editable status, verified deployment outcomes, live acceptance, rollout and required soaks remain open. No child issue closed.
